title: 🌐 India–EU Free Trade Agreement Concluded — 15 Bank Branches, 100% Insurance FDI & Euratom
summary: India and EU concluded FTA negotiations on 26 Jan 2026 ("Mother of all deals"). EU is India's 2nd largest goods trading partner (€120B in 2024; EU FDI in India €132B). India-Euratom nuclear cooperation signed. India allows EU banks to open 15 branches over 4 years and binds 100% insurance FDI.
